components.name: Archive Detail Contract
components.description: The archive-world remains scoped to card detail and retains board/tissue/ink, square rules, and exact-printing framing.

narrative.overview: Home and Trade are bright card-shop counter scenes distilled for ordinary collectors: find a card, inspect honest value evidence, then operate a two-sided decision bench when comparing a trade. Warm bench, paper, ink, and orange tokens frame exact identity, current/stale/unpriced states, and clear actions. Archive-world remains the card-detail contract.
keyCharacteristics: Square rules and warm bench/paper/ink/orange palette.
Barlow Condensed action hierarchy with Azeret Mono evidence only.
Accessible mode switch, direct Find a card search, honest unavailable Sealed mode, collapsed How prices work details, and one reveal motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Keep the decision-world on Home and Trade and preserve archive-world for card detail; do not merge their visual contracts.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Show exact identity, discriminators, source/methodology, and current/fresh, stale, or unpriced status without fabricated precision.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Make search and one value-details action clear, with 44px-class touch targets and keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Use the shared external 250ms CardAutocomplete hook so query, input node, focus, caret/selection, and composition survive result updates; keep active options stable, visibly ruled, and internally scrollable.

rules.name: The Trade Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep two symmetric square ledgers, exact identity, 44px controls, visible acquisition status, stale/unpriced honesty, and no implied share/copy or PLN capability before those pieces exist.

dos: Do keep Singles as the default Home mode and state Sealed honestly unavailable.
Do use square geometry, warm bench/paper/ink/orange tokens, and vertical price rows.
Do preserve the archive-world contract on card detail.
Do keep methodology, policy, non-affiliation, shipping, and unavailable-price caveats in collapsed details.
Do provide one bench-reveal motion and disable it for reduced motion.
donts: Don't imply sealed, PLN conversion, share/copy controls, seller-count, language, condition, finish, or Poland-shipping capability.
Don't hide stale or unpriced estimates behind decorative treatment.
Don't replace either scoped world with generic rounded marketplace cards, glass, or gradients.
